The candidate meta-principles are not compatible as foundations. Brooks's law concerns project delay from added staff, not a general restriction on communicating agents. Other candidates address cascades, memory, privacy, scaling, or coordination and have no defensible relation to the claim. The claim is sound as a bounded empirical observation but has no compatible root among the supplied candidates.
